description: Issue #145: the two reading paths the JA fixture beside this one does not exercise. #451 is English prose ("Add a unit test that asserts …") — this repository's issues and fixtures are written in both languages, so a detector that reads only one is half a detector. #452 names the test file itself in prose, un-backticked (`test_render.c`), which is the ONLY reason that branch exists: the body extractor reads an un-backticked token as a path only when it contains a "/", so exactly those mentions never become suspected files, and "_test" / "test_" carry no word boundary either, so the noun rule cannot see the test in them. #452 therefore fires through the path branch alone, and `test_render.c` is provably absent from its suspected_files.

warning_details_include: #451: Acceptance asks for a test but no test path is among the affected files; name it in the issue body, or say no new test is needed. Criterion: "Add a unit test that asserts a relative prefix is rejected"
